nodes.label: Instruções: Adicionar 30 Exercícios por Lezione (Módulo A1)
nodes.norm_label: instrucoes: adicionar 30 exercicios por lezione (modulo a1)
nodes.rationale: Add 30 extra exercises (mixing 'revelar' and 'escolha') to each of the 9 A1 lessons in data/grammar.json, inserting them before existing 'escolha' verification exercises so original book tests stay at the end.

nodes.label: Instruções: Melhorar Explicações dos Exercícios (grammar.json)
nodes.rationale: Replace generic one-word exercise explanations in grammar.json with pedagogical 80-150 char explanations in Portuguese covering the grammatical rule, regular/irregular status, auxiliary/participle agreement, and temporal markers.

nodes.label: Schema Curricular A1, A2, B1, B2 (Moduli e Unità)
nodes.norm_label: schema curricular a1, a2, b1, b2 (moduli e unita)
nodes.rationale: Defines the progression from A1 (Parla e Scrivi base grammar) to A2 (survival/immersion), B1 (21st-century contemporary/digital/workplace Italian), and B2 (high-level business, literature, cinema, politics).

nodes.label: Expansão das 21 Histórias Filosóficas (Resultado Final)
nodes.rationale: Provide 21 expanded philosophical stories (15 paragraphs each, 315 total) in C2 narrative Italian with fluent pt-BR translations and 2-4 IPA vocabulary terms per paragraph to give historical context, emotional connection, and retention.

nodes.label: IT Language Monogram
nodes.rationale: Bold Georgia serif 'IT' text centered beneath the Roman arch representing the Italian language ISO code.

nodes.label: Roman Arch Emblem
nodes.rationale: Composed of left and right pillars, column capitals, column bases, base lintel, semicircular arch path, inner dashed arch line, and an apex keystone.

nodes.label: Apprendimento Italiano App Icon
nodes.rationale: 512x512 vector app icon featuring a crimson gradient background (#9B2335 to #7A1C2A) and a golden (#E8C87A to #C9A84C) Roman arch motif with 'IT' monogram and five decorative dots/stars to evoke classical Italian heritage and language learning.

nodes.label: Crimson and Gold Classical Color Palette
nodes.norm_label: crimson and gold classical color palette
nodes.rationale: Defines linear gradients #bg (crimson/burgundy #9B2335-#7A1C2A) and #gold (#E8C87A-#C9A84C) with cream (#F5EDD8) accents for a warm, classical Roman aesthetic.
